A nice European touch in Hanoi
Feb 2026 • Couples
After two weeks of Vietnamese food, we were ready for a change. And we are so glad we did!! The wine was fabulous, our salads were on point and the Australian beef was cooked to perfection! We hope many more people will enjoy this restaurant too. The wine prices were barely marked up and we enjoyed a nice Australian Shiraz that was a nice compliment to both our salads and meat entrees. It’s a bit easy to miss the entry, just a small sign that says Oak Wine. But if you venture up the stairs, you will be glad you did!!!

Lovely place
Nov 2025 • Family
It’s my nth visit to Oak, yet every time it still feels as warm and special as the first.
Recently, I celebrated my birthday there with my family. We ordered beef, pasta, and salmon — the beef was perfectly cooked, the salmon was fresh, and the pasta was absolutely delicious. Even my daughter, who’s usually a bit picky, finished her pasta in no time and even had some of my beef!
Now that autumn has arrived, enjoying a cozy evening at Oak feels truly relaxing and delightful. I’ll definitely be coming back again and again

Best Wine Bar in Hanoi
Mar 2024 • Couples
This little wine bar is a must do in old Hanoi. Nestled above the street, walking distance from Hoan Kiem lake, they have an extensive, yet reasonably priced selection of wines and some simple, but fabulous dishes. We sat out on the balcony and watched the city drift past! The staff were incredibly friendly, and you would be hard pressed to have better warm fresh bread and butter in all on Vietnam (or France for that matter)! Definitely recommend giving this place a try!

Great food, wine, service and music.
Jan 2024 • Couples
We went to the Oak Wine Boutique yesterday. Love that the entrance is down an alley and up some stairs. We sat on the balcony above the fray and enjoyed a glass of white wine while the city bustled below. Some friends joined us for dinner- lamb chops, steak and noodles shared between us - and of course more wine. The service was great, very friendly and just close enough. Also the music was so nice, all of us remarked on it - jazz, but did not compete with the conversation. ☺️
